links.outcome: Agreement of deployed AI ICH detection outputs with radiologist review on sampled scans
links.effect: Overall agreement 93.5% (95% CI 92.1-94.8), PPA 85.7% (77.8-91.6), NPA 94.3% (92.8-95.5), Gwet's AC1 0.92; 16 false negatives, 9 were subarachnoid haemorrhages.
links.quote: Overall agreement, positive percent agreement, negative percent agreement, and Gwet's AC1 of AI with radiologists were found to be 93.5% (95% CI, 92.1-94.8), 85.7% (77.8-91.6), 94.3% (92.8-95.5) and 0.92 (0.90-0.94), respectively, in detecting ICH.

screen.reason: The study conducts a post-implementation clinical audit and failure analysis of an intracranial hemorrhage detection AI tool deployed across 44 hospitals in a teleradiology network.
